content: {"phoneNote":"The header already carries a Pokličite button and Navodila za pot link, yet the hero repeats both as bare underlined text links (Pokličite nas, Pot do nas), so the first screen offers four calls to action with weak styling.","desktopNote":"Hero links are weak text underlines beside a strong header button, and the Vlečna služba section is a near-empty band with a lone word „Gorenjska", "phone": {"impression": 3, "hierarchy": 3, "imagery": 4, "spacing": 3, "clutter": 2, "distinctiveness": 3}, "desktop": {"impression": 3, "hierarchy": 3, "imagery": 4, "spacing": 3, "clutter": 2, "distinctiveness": 3}, "fixes": ["Remove the duplicated hero text links (Pokličite nas, Pot do nas) or make one of them the single styled primary button; the header already carries the call and directions actions.", "Give the Vlečna služba za Gorenjsko section real content or merge it into the services card; the stray word „Gorenjska", " and the empty band look unfinished.", "Fill the empty third slot in the services grid on desktop (a photo for Vlečna služba) and use the service photos larger so the page feels less like a text template."], "blockers": ["Both viewports, Vlečna služba section: an orphan word „Gorenjska", " sits alone under the intro like leftover placeholder text, making the section look broken."]}
